name: The Journey Begins
description: Travel to the Glittering Meadows to begin your adventure.

narrative.accept: Guard Captain Vaelen looks you over. "Welcome to Oakhaven, recruit. The road ahead is dangerous. Start by traveling to the Glittering Meadows and scout the area."
narrative.complete: "Ah, you made it back. Excellent. The meadows are beautiful but full of pests. Let's get you prepared for real combat."
narrative.hint: Travel to the Glittering Meadows using the Travel menu on your Map.
